stub.section: Elk Creek Road bridge to Lake Switzerland

detail.description:
Bob Burke shared:

"The 'Lake' Switzerland dam has been gone for a year. The EPA removed it for safety reasons.

"A good place to take out would be on the East Branch of the Delaware in Margaretville, NY. That would be Vly Creek to Bushkill to Dry Brook to the East Branch Delaware River. ThereÂs no public access to Vly Creek above where 'Lake' Switzerland used to be."

Located upstream from [Bush Kill](https://www.americanwhitewater.org/content/River/detail/id/1450/). Combine to make a longer trip.
